verdict.rationale: First-party pages describe a 'fully self-service Contract Generator platform' used by hundreds of clients, a tailored DIY contract generator inside GDHQ, and client self-serve generation of real agreements such as offer letters, PIIAs and invention assignments at no cost. The web-based D&O Questionnaire Portal adds online completion of real legal questionnaires beyond static PDFs. Access is limited to clients via GDHQ/Catalyze. Missing for 10: detail on the interactive assembly flow (questionnaire logic, document types beyond employment), coverage of founder-specific documents like formation or SAFEs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
